utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Rosa, I haven’t got the repair drive on my list yet—where did you last see it?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I last had the repair drive notes here on my clipboard, but I may have mixed them with the supply list. Let me check and I’ll get back to you right away.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Rosa—I'll wait for your update. If it turns up with the supply list, could you let me know where you found it?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Quinn—I'm still catching up on the details myself, so just let folks know it’s for the repair drive and to keep an eye out for updates.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, Nell—I’ll spread the word and keep it simple: it’s for the repair drive, and I’ll tell neighbors to watch for updates.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Quinn—I appreciate it. I’m still getting the updates myself, so that should be perfect.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Oren — that’s perfect. I’ll send you the time for the repair drive, and I’d appreciate those tools and screws when you can bring them by.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can bring the screws by, and I’m happy to help with the repair drive too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That would be a huge help, Rey—thank you. I’ll send along the time and details, and we can put your help to good use.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I can bring over the screwdriver set and those extra screws. Just remind me of the time again, and I’ll make sure I don’t forget.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Oren — can you remind me of the time and the exact location for the repair drive? I just want to make sure I’ve got it right.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure — I just need you to remind me of the time and exact spot again too, and I’ll bring the screwdriver set and extra screws.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sure — send me the tool list, and I’ll help sort the drop-off side around school pickup times.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Great, I’ll send over the tool list. I’m a bit fuzzy on the timing still, but I’ll check the notice and get back to you about the drop-off spot.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks — once you’ve checked the notice, send me the drop-off spot and I’ll work it around pickup times.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Uli — if you hear anything about the repair drive, just let me know and I’ll spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Gus. I could really use help with the front gate, if anyone’s available.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I’ll see who’s available for the front gate and pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard the latest on the repair drive yet, but I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Ira — if you hear anything, let me know. I’m mostly waiting on the timing and drop-off spot so I can pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — I’ll ask around while I’m out and let you know as soon as I hear the timing and drop-off spot.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Just help me keep the plan tidy — if you can sort the tools and tell me what’s still missing, that’d be great.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure — I’ll help sort the tools and let you know what’s still missing for the repair drive. I’ll keep an eye out for any new details too.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, that keeps it simple — let me know once you’ve got the missing list, and we’ll go from there.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, I can do that. I’ll sort the donated tools and set them out by the garage now.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’d be a big help, Sam—thanks. I’ll let folks know the tools are getting sorted and set out by the garage now.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Happy to help, Tess—I’ll keep sorting them out by the garage now.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, I think so — but please double-check the time and drop-off spot so nothing gets missed.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — I’ll double-check the time and drop-off spot. Thanks for confirming.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks — once you’ve got the details, let me know so I can be sure everything’s in the right place.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late—what do you need help with for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: We’re collecting tools and spare parts—bring whatever you’ve got, and I’ll sort the rest.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I can bring a few tools and some spare parts. Just tell me where to drop them off.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Bo — if you’ve got any spare tools, tape, or batteries, that’d be great. And if you can swing by around 6, we can sort everything out.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’ll bring whatever tools, tape, or batteries I can find and swing by around 6.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Bo — that really helps.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’d be great, thanks. Let me know the list once you’ve got it together, and I’ll keep the plan tidy.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Will do — I’ll put together a simple tool list and send it over soon. Thanks, Eli.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great, Dane — send it over when it’s ready, and I’ll keep everything in order here.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’ll check with the teacher after pickup and let you know what I find. If you spot the repair drive near the school office, give me a heads-up.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Will do — I’ll keep an eye out near the school office and let you know if I see it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Bo — I appreciate it. I’ll ask the teacher after pickup and update you as soon as I know more.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Bo. Bring whatever tools and spare parts you can find, and I’ll sort the rest.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Leo — I’ll bring over whatever tools and spare parts I can round up.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Gus—much appreciated. Just drop them by when you can, and I’ll take it from there.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, I can do that. I’ll sort the donated tools and set them out by the garage now.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Sam — I really appreciate it. If you notice anything we’re still short on, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: You got it, Rosa — I’ll keep an eye out and let you know if I spot anything we still need.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you let me know the date, time, and exact location for the repair drive? I want to make sure I have the details right before I help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’m still waiting on the final details, so I don’t want to guess. As soon as I have the date, time, and exact spot, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Uli — please let me know as soon as you have the final details, and I’ll help spread the word then.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’ve got your name down, and I’ll spread the word to a few more neighbors too. Thanks for the heads-up about donations, Tess; I’ll remind folks to bring anything they can.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll keep track of the supplies and let you know if we’re short on anything. Could you remind Oren about the time, and I’ll cover the rest here?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Of course — I’ll remind Oren about the time and spread the word to the others, too. Thanks for covering things there, Cleo.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Pia. Rey says it’s a broken shelf, a loose door hinge, and a couple of lamps that need rewiring — I’m still checking on the timing and drop-off spot.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Mina — once you have the timing and drop-off spot, I’ll fit it into my schedule.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — I’ll confirm the timing and drop-off spot and send them over as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard the latest on the repair drive yet, but I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive is still happening today, right? I’ll double-check the time and drop-off spot so nothing gets missed.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds right to me — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out, and let me know if the time or drop-off spot changes.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yep, I’ve been telling folks it’s for the repair drive and to keep an eye out for the details. I’ll pass along any updates as I get them.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Vik — I appreciate you spreading the word. If you get the date, time, and location, send them my way and I’ll share them around too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — once I get the date, time, and location, I’ll pass them along right away.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’ve got that screwdriver set and some extra screws I can bring by. Just give me a nudge on the time again—I’m a bit foggy on that part.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’s great, Oren—every little bit helps. I’ll let you know the time again as soon as I can, and I’ll pass your donation along.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Tess. I appreciate it—just remind me when you’ve got the time, and I’ll bring the tools over.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Rey — if you’ve got any spare tools, tape, or batteries, that’d be a big help. And if you can make it by around 6, we can sort everything out together.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can bring some tape and batteries, and I should be able to make it by 6.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, thanks, Rey — tape and batteries will be a big help. See you around 6!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll head by the school office and see if it’s there. If you hear back from the teacher, let me know right away.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Opal — I’m still getting the updates myself, so I’ll pass along anything I hear right away.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect, thanks, Nell — I’ll check the school office now and keep you posted.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
